hotels.title: Five-Star Bogor Pullman Stay with Sweeping Mountain Vistas, Multiple Pools & Four Onsite Bars & Restaurants
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in a serene fusion of luxury and nature at this peaceful five-star retreat in West Java’s lush landscapes. Surrounded by vibrant rice paddies and tea plantations, this resort is the ideal escape, complete with a spa and wellness centre for total relaxation across 14 picturesque hectares. Indulge in authentic Indonesian flavours at Damar Restaurant or sip a refreshing drink at the poolside bar. With four inviting pools, diverse dining venues and bars onsite, every moment here is crafted for enjoyment. Just a short drive away, discover the beauty of the Bogor Botanical Gardens and the historic Bogor Palace.
